auth.setup.title: Administrator account setup
auth.setup.intro: You do this setup one time only. Select the administrator USERNAME and the login password.
auth.setup.username_hint: 3 to 30 characters that start with a lowercase letter. Only lowercase English letters, digits, and the underscore (_) are permitted.
auth.setup.password_hint: {min_password_length} characters or more. Only English letters, digits, and standard special characters ({password_chars}) are permitted. Spaces and Korean characters are not permitted. The password must not contain the USERNAME.
auth.setup.confirm_immutable: You cannot change the USERNAME after you confirm it.
auth.setup.confirm_public: In network mode the address /@USERNAME is public.
auth.username.syntax: The USERNAME format is not correct. Use 3 to 30 lowercase English letters, digits, and underscores that start with a lowercase letter. Two underscores in sequence and an underscore at the end are not permitted.
auth.username.retired: This USERNAME is retired and is not available.
auth.username.taken: This USERNAME is already in use.
auth.password.invalid_characters: Only English letters, digits, and standard special characters (ASCII punctuation) are permitted in the password. Spaces, Korean characters, and all other characters are not permitted.
auth.password.too_short: The password must have {min_password_length} characters or more.
auth.password.contains_username: The password must not contain the USERNAME.
auth.password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.form.display_name: The display name must have 64 characters or less and no control characters.
